title: Can't kill "Select Godot Engine (Console)" window; "Access denied"
body: ### Tested versions Encountered in 4.6.2 mono ### System information Windows 10, Godot 4.6.2 ### Issue description One of the Godot editors(or perhaps the project selector's?) console windows has somehow become unkillable. I've closed the editor, but this console window still remains, and not even task manager is able to kill it. If I try to kill it with Task Manager, it says "Access denied"...which is incredibly disturbing, because Godot should definitely _not_ have any sort of elevated status. I have no idea how to reproduce this, but it was disturbing enough for me to want to report this anyway. Could be some kind of security issue.
